reason: I already have my own bike and ride it everywhere, including to training. I don't need to pay for another one, and with only 10 bikes I couldn't count on one being there anyway.
objection: I already have my own bike, so why would I pay 12 euros a month for one I have to go find in an app?
would_change_my_mind: If my bike got stolen or broke, I might pay 1.50 for a few rides until it's fixed, but only if a bike is actually near me when I need it.
